# Hasanat skills for coding agents

These are copies of the companion skills from the verified Hasanat skills pack, version `2026.11.12.3`. They tell a coding agent how to use shared sign-in, Cloudflare D1, deployment and managed hosting, and the Hasanat design.

If an instruction here differs from the pack, the pack is newer. Download and verify the current pack from <https://platform.hasanat.dev/coding-agent/skills-pack/>.
